count_metadata_contract.identity_rule: Join by feature_key and, when sample_id is present, by the source sample ID. A block_id is required for multiple analyzed blocks.
count_metadata_contract.delta_rule: Delta fits require sample-level counts. Summarize by the minimum count over source observations in retained complete pairs only; feature-only values are unavailable for this representation.
count_metadata_contract.path_resolution_handoff: Sol resolves statistics.count_metadata relative to the YAML config file and passes the resolved local table to B-T05. The worker code also accepts an in-memory table for tests.

stage_b_serialization_handoff: R/results_b.R currently serializes only status, limma_version, and blocks. Preserve method/requested_method, DEqMS version/API fields, unavailable_reason, fallback_applied, deqms_status, and fallback_provenance in the Stage B artifact so an unavailable route and an explicit limma fallback remain distinguishable after serialization.
request: Sol adds DEqMS 1.30.0 to the supported optional dependency/lock, preserves the existing namespace exports, integrates the B-T05 fit wrapper after the B-T02/B-T03 dispatchers, resolves count_metadata against config_path in the CLI path, and serializes method/unavailable/fallback provenance as listed above. Retain the null-count example as an explicit named unavailable result. Do not alter the canonical spec or another packet's files.
example_note: B-T05.yaml uses the synthetic B-T03 paired fixture and requests DEqMS without adding an out-of-allowlist static count file. It exercises the explicit unavailable route. The B-T05 behavioral suite exercises qualified DEqMS fits with public synthetic keyed count tables.
